given: a Staff Member whose role, shipped or composed by the Organization, holds front_desk.check_in or front_desk.check_out
then: the front-desk focus leads: arrivals and departures first; the role's name plays no part, so a custom role gets the same screen as the shipped one

given: a role holding housekeeping.update_status and finance.manage_folio but no front-desk permission
then: housekeeping leads; any balance they may see reaches attention, and the money figures stay the finance focus's own, because the shipped Front desk role holds finance.manage_folio and a literal union would put the Folio card on every front desk. Precedence is manager, front desk, housekeeping, finance

given: a Staff Member without finance.manage_folio, such as the shipped Housekeeping role
when: the summary is read for them
then: it carries no balance, no amount and no 'leaves owing' item: the server leaves them out, so nothing is hidden in the page that devtools could show

given: a Property without the housekeeping capability, or without billing
then: the cards for that module are absent, not zero and not greyed out; the rest of the page is unchanged

given: a Property in another Organization, or one the Staff Member is not assigned to
when: its id is sent to the summary route
then: the answer is the same empty summary a nonexistent Property gets; nothing distinguishes the two

given: a property parameter that is not a uuid
then: it answers an empty summary rather than a 500, as the arrivals route does

given: a request with no session or an ended one
then: it answers 401 with no body, never a redirect a polling screen would parse as data

given: a ?property= naming no Property the viewer has Today at
then: it redirects to plain /today, as it already does, rather than showing the first Property's day under a switcher naming none
test_name: today.spec.ts: a Property named in the URL that Today does not reach goes back to Today with none

given: a Property whose business date cutoff (04:00 by default) has not yet passed
then: every figure is for the working day, which is still yesterday; the heading names the working day and says the clock has moved on (ADR 0021)

given: Reservations starting on the business date, some checked in, some confirmed, some cancelled or no-show
then: 'checked in of expected' counts checked-in and still-to-come; cancelled and no-show are in neither number

given: a check-in withdrawn with a reason (ADR 0022), so its Reservation is confirmed again
then: the Guest counts as still to arrive, not as checked in

given: Stays due to leave on the business date, some departed, one due yesterday and still in house
then: 'out of due' counts today's due Stays still here and every Stay checked out today — a check-out records the day it happened, so early leavers and formerly overdue Guests count as gone today; those still here past their date are counted separately as overdue and appear in attention

situation: Arrival into a room not ready
given: an arrival still to come whose room housekeeping has not made ready
then: it is an attention item naming the room, and the Guest for a viewer who works with Guests, opening Arrivals; for a viewer whose work is the room it opens the housekeeping board instead. Opening at the booking itself is slice 2

given: a Stay in house past its planned departure
then: it is an attention item naming the room, the Guest and the day they were due, opening Departures

given: a Stay due out today or overdue whose Folio balance is above zero, and a viewer holding finance.manage_folio
then: a Guest due out today with a balance is an attention item carrying the amount in the Property's currency, opening that Folio; one who is also overdue is the single overdue item carrying the amount and opens Departures (TD-S1-14). The word is balance, never unpaid, because payments are not recorded

situation: An arrival that cannot be checked in
given: an arrival whose check-in has a blocker, such as a bed still occupied
then: it is an attention item stating the blocker, opening Arrivals

given: a room, or a single bed in a room that is otherwise let, out of service; a blocked unit is not one
when: the summary is read by a viewer with the housekeeping or front-desk focus
then: it is an attention item naming the room, or the bed and its room, opening the housekeeping board, or Rooms where there is none; a blocked unit is a decision with a reason and is not listed. Read from the unit map, so it needs the front desk capability; a Property with housekeeping and no front desk lists none

given: more attention items than fit one row
then: items are ordered not-ready arrival, blocked arrival, overdue, balance, out of service; the first four show and the rest are one 'N more' item

given: no item of any kind
then: one calm line says so; the row does not disappear, so its absence is never mistaken for a failure

given: sellable units, Stays in house, arrivals still to come and departures still due
then: occupancy is in-house over sellable; 'expected tonight' adds arrivals to come and removes departures still due; with no sellable unit neither is a percentage and the tile says there are no units to let

given: dirty rooms, some with an arrival today, some whose Guest leaves today, some neither
then: rooms with an arrival today come first, then clean rooms awaiting inspection with an arrival, then rooms still occupied by a Guest leaving today, then the rest by how long they have been dirty

situation: Every figure is a way in
given: any tile, attention item or row
then: it lands on the list that explains it, carrying ?property= so the Property does not change, as a client navigation like the rail's; filtered to the figure only where that list has a filter (Folio by ?folio=) — the arrivals, departures and housekeeping lists have none yet

given: a Property with no arrivals and no departures today
then: the figures read zero where they always are; the movements card is an empty state that says so and offers Reservations

given: one module's read fails while the others answer
then: that section is marked unavailable and the failure is logged on the server; the others are unaffected and the card offers a retry

given: a later refresh of the summary fails
then: the last numbers stay, and the freshness line says they are from their time rather than now

given: another Staff Member checks a Guest in at another desk
then: the figures follow within 60 seconds, and at once on focus or after this viewer's own action; the dashboard only reads, so nothing conflicts

given: Turkish, English or Arabic
then: all copy is in that language, numbers, dates and money are formatted by it, and Arabic mirrors by logical utilities alone

given: a viewport below md
then: attention comes first, then the focus's list, then the figures two across; nothing scrolls sideways
test_name: today.spec.ts: on a phone Today leads with the task and never scrolls sideways

given: a Staff Member with memberships in two Organizations
when: Today is opened at a Property of one
then: every figure and permission is that Organization's; nothing from the other appears

given: a Staff Member with Today at a Property but no module whose cards they may see
then: the working day and clock show, and one line says there is nothing here for their role yet, rather than an empty grid

given: a Staff Member
then: it greets them by display name, falling back to the part of their email before the @, never the full address

given: an arrival row and a viewer holding front_desk.check_in
when: they check the Guest in from the row
then: it is the Arrivals dialog and command, unchanged, including the not-ready warning; the figures refresh at once

given: a departure row and a viewer holding front_desk.check_out
when: they check the Guest out from the row
then: it is the Departures dialog and command, unchanged, including the balance review and reason

given: a clean-first row and a viewer holding housekeeping.update_status
when: they mark the room clean or inspected
then: it is the board's command, unchanged; a room with a Guest still in it offers no action and says why

given: a row and a viewer without the command's permission
then: the row offers no action, only the way in; the command would refuse anyway

given: an attention item or a row naming one booking or Stay
then: deferred: the list opens at the Property, not at the booking or Stay, until the lists take an id to open at; none does yet

given: a viewer holding audit.read
when: Today renders with the manager focus
then: the five newest audit records they may read appear, each opening that record; without audit.read the card is absent

given: a viewer holding finance.manage_folio
then: charges less reversals posted on the business date appear as one figure opening Finance

given: a viewer who reaches more than one Property
then: a strip names each with its occupancy and attention count; choosing one is a full load, like the switcher (ADR 0019); with one Property the strip is absent

given: Reservations and Stays over the next 14 days
when: Today renders with the manager focus
then: a line of booked occupancy per day, with a visually hidden table of the same values; it is bookings, not a forecast model

given: blueprint 18.4 lists unresolved requests
then: deferred: no requests module exists; it adds its card when it does

given: blueprint 18.4 lists maintenance blockers
then: superseded by TD-S4-01 to TD-S4-06

given: blueprint 18.4 lists shift handover notes
then: deferred: no handover notes exist; closing the day (#72) closes a business date and records no notes

given: blueprint 18.4 lists them
then: deferred: none of the modules exists

given: a revenue snapshot
then: deferred: no rates exist, so revenue would be invented; S3's charges posted today is the honest figure until then

given: blueprint 20.7 item 10
then: deferred: positions are fixed per focus for muscle memory until saved views exist

given: a Guest still in house after the Property's check-out time
then: deferred: no Property has a check-out time; overdue means an earlier day until one does

given: a role holding only maintenance permissions and none of front desk, housekeeping, finance or manager
then: deferred: such a role leads nowhere (TD-S1-30), so nothing of maintenance is read for it; a maintenance focus is designed when a shipped role needs one

given: an attention item or figure naming one request
then: deferred: the maintenance board has no id to open at; it opens the board at the Property until it does

given: a maintenance request of priority urgent, not done or cancelled, at the Property, and a viewer holding maintenance.report or maintenance.manage
then: it is an attention item naming its number and title and the room or equipment it concerns, opening the maintenance board; a viewer without either permission is not shown it

situation: Out of order past its return
given: a room held out of order by a request whose expected return date is before the business date
then: it is an attention item saying the room was due back on that date, opening the maintenance board, and it replaces the plain out-of-service item for that room: one item per room, the earliest-due hold when several requests hold it; an open urgent request holding the room absorbs its hold items and shows its own due-back date; due back on the business date is not yet past

given: a room out of service because a maintenance request holds it, and a viewer holding a maintenance permission
then: the out-of-service item (TD-S1-17) names the request and opens the maintenance board instead of the housekeeping board; a viewer without a maintenance permission keeps TD-S1-17 as it is

given: the manager focus, the maintenance capability on, and a maintenance permission held
then: a card shows open requests (new, in progress, waiting for parts) and rooms out of order, each figure opening the maintenance board with ?property=; done and cancelled are not counted, and out of order counts distinct Units, beds included, however many requests hold each; the board it opens still counts holding requests until MT-S2-32

given: the maintenance capability off at the Property
then: no maintenance card and no maintenance attention items; TD-S1-17 is unchanged

given: the maintenance read fails while the rest of Today reads
then: the maintenance card is unavailable with a retry and the attention list is marked incomplete (TD-S1-24); nothing else is withheld
